what.text: This page follows refugees from Georgia living in Russia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 91 Georgian refugees in Russia, 0.5% of all refugees from Georgia.
France hosts the most Georgian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Ireland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Georgia over the government from 1991 to 1993 and over Abkhazia territory in 1992 and 1993.
It also records armed conflict over South Ossetia territory in 1992, 2004 and 2008.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at its highest figure, 47762 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1996 to 1999, and the figure has fallen since.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Russia.
These are year-end totals for Russia only, reported to UNHCR.
